Humans (人族, Jinzoku) are the most dominant race in the world. Similar to humans on earth, the human race in the Human World have relatively weak physique, short lifespan and high intelligence such that most innovations in the world are the work of humans and have the most developed civilization compared to other races. They are the majority race in the Central Continent, Begaritt Continent and Millis Continent. Humans on the Central Continent and Millis Continent speaks Human Tongue with slightly differing accents, whereas humans on Begaritt Continent speaks Fighting God tongue. Elves (長耳族エルフ, Erufu, lit. "Long Ear Tribe") are a race of people who currently live in the southern part of the Great Forest in the Millis Continent. They are sometimes classified as demon race, but it was possible that they are new species that developed during the Chaotic Period. As their name implies, their most prominent physical characteristic is their long and pointy ears, which provides them with very good hearing ability. Other than that, they usually have a slim body, whereas female elves tend to be flat-chested. Their fertility is rather low, but they have very long lifespans, capable of staying in their prime for hundreds of years. They also have a very good sense of direction, able to navigate effortlessly even in difficult terrains like the Great Forest and deserts. It is said that magic was originally created by the High Elves, the ancestors of Elves.

Dwarves (炭鉱族ドワーフ, Dowaafu, lit. "Coal Mine Tribe") are a race of people who currently live at the foot of the Blue Dragon Mountain Range in the Millis Continent. They are sometimes classified as demon race, but it was possible that they are new species that developed during the Chaotic Period. Dwarves are short in height: male dwarves have a stout build, whereas female dwarves are similar to young human females. They love alcohol and are highly tolerant against it. Their lifespan is longer of humans, capable of living for at least several hundred years. As a race of craftsmen and blacksmiths by birth, dwarves have naturally dexterous hands and high affinity towards earth and fire magic, but abhorred water and wind magic. They are adept in crafting weapons, armors and various arts, and the best craftsman would have the chance to ascend as the Ore God.

Dragon Race (龍族, Ryuzoku) are the original inhabitants of the Dragon World, and the strongest of all races in terms of fundamental physical capabilities. They have wings, powerful talons and tough scales, and are the first race that could wield battle aura effectively. They could live for more than a hundred thousand years, thus they only have children every several thousand years. After the fall of the five remaining worlds, most of the dragon race perished with the Dragon World, whereas many of the remaining members escaped to the Human World were killed by other races as an act of vengeance. Demon Race (魔族, Mazoku) are the original inhabitants of the Demon World. The classification of Demon Race are less specific during recent times, and it became the umbrella term for the races sided with Kishirika during the Great Human-Demon Wars. As a result, some races originally belonging to Beast Race are also categorized as Demon Race. There are a significant number of species, with very diverse range of physiology, abilities, and lifespan. Most Demon Race are bipedal humanoids that are radically different in appearance when compared to humans, but there are a few exceptions. Their primary language is Demon God Tongue. There are some exceptionally powerful individuals among the Demon Race that become rulers of a certain region, which are known as Demon Kings (魔王, Maou). The one stood on top of all of them is the Demon Empress Kishirika Kishirisu.

bolumler.metin: According to research conducted by the ancient Dragon Tribe, the Six Worlds are permeated by a common form of power. This power was known by different names in the individual worlds: in the Dragon World it was called , while in the Demon World it was called . Every living creature native to the Six Worlds possesses this power. Ancient Dragon Tribe researchers discovered that absorbing abnormally large concentrations of it could transform animals into Monsters and could cause humans to develop unusually powerful or specialized characteristics. This power also naturally tends toward equilibrium among the Six Worlds. If the amount present in one world decreases significantly, power is drawn from another world to compensate. The resulting transfer can carry trees, animals and people with it, producing naturally occurring teleportation phenomena that were once regarded as mysterious disappearances. Nanahoshi Shizuka is an exceptional case because she possesses no mana of her own.

Mana is held within living bodies and can be deliberately manipulated for Magic, Battle Aura, and other supernatural techniques. Several abnormal conditions involve the accumulation or alteration of mana within the body. Elinalise Dragonroad's curse causes mana to accumulate until it is crystallized into mana crystals, while Petrification Syndrome gradually transforms the victim's body into magic stone. Dryne Syndrome instead results from mana entering and accumulating within a body that lacks the normal ability to neutralize it. ==Magic==

Mana capacity is the amount of mana that an individual's body is capable of containing and using. A larger reserve allows a person to cast more spells, expend greater amounts of mana, or sustain mana-consuming abilities for longer periods before exhaustion. Mana capacity is commonly believed to be inherited and fixed at birth. However, Rudeus Greyrat demonstrated that a person's mana reserve can be substantially increased through repeated use of mana during early childhood, a principle later supported through the magical education of Juliette. The Laplace Factor can influence an individual's magical potential without determining their final mana reserve. According to Orsted, Rudeus was born with a body capable of containing an extraordinary quantity of mana because of the factor, but the enormous reserve he ultimately developed was the result of repeatedly exhausting and developing his mana during childhood. Without that training, his mana would have remained only somewhat greater than that of an ordinary person, comparable to Sylphiette. Mana capacity alone does not determine a magician's effectiveness.

The Teleport Incident, also known as Metastasis Event, is a Mana calamity that occurred in the Fittoa Region, Asura Kingdom in K417 which resulted in its citizens being teleported to random locations on the world. The incident caused an innumerable amount of casualties and was the first turning point in Rudeus Greyrat's life in the series. ==Prelude==

Since the era of the Six-Faced World, numerous teleportation incidents has already occurred but in a smaller scale which is also one of the reasons why there is animosity between the worlds because of suspicions of one world might be invading the other for the disappearance of their people or appearance of monsters. But according to the Dragon Tribe researchers' hypothesis: a power possessed by every living creature permeates the Six Worlds which is called Dragon Battle Aura by the Dragon Tribe while the Demons call it Mana or Magic Power that is said to maintain a natural equilibrium within the Six Worlds. However, the power of the Six Worlds suddenly declined, creating significant imbalances. If the power diminishes significantly in one world, it'll absorb power from another world to compensate which results to the teleport incident, causing not only trees and animals but also people to disappear. Although Teleportation Magic is forbidden by the First Dragon God because it may trigger a war, research is still conducted by all beings of the Six Worlds. For Dragon Tribe, this research is assigned to Crystal and later inherited by Dora.

The cause of the Teleportation accident was actually events taking place roughly 80 years in the future. At this time, a certain nation was embroiled in a war and used the power of an individual known as the "Playback Miko" to summon a boy from another world, who was prophesied to be their savior. The Miko would grow close to the summoned hero and eventually develop feelings for him. Unfortunately, the boy was actually just an ordinary human and he ended up dying when the country forced him onto the battlefield. Overcome with grief, the Miko burnt out her power, to bend time and space, to alter the world to one where she and the boy might live happily together. To successfully alter history, the Playback Miko reached out with her power and found an individual with similar feelings for the boy as herself: his girlfriend from his original world. She then attempted to summon her to her current location, the Fittoa Region, roughly 80 years in the past. The Miko's hope was that this would allow her to set things up so that the boy would not have to die.

The are a ranking of seven warriors recognized among the strongest in the world. The system was established by the Technique God around the end of the Second Human-Demon War. Unlike a continuously updated measure of combat strength, the Seven Great Powers functions through succession. Its positions change when a ranked Power is defeated or replaced, while the monuments associated with the ranking automatically reflect the resulting change. ==History==
===Establishment===
Around the end of the Second Human-Demon War, after Laplace had been divided into the Technique God and the Demon

bolumler.metin:
Around the end of the Second Human-Demon War, after Laplace had been divided into the Technique God and the Demon God, the Technique God established the Seven Great Powers. The provisional upper ranking was:

#Technique God
#Demon God
#Fighting God
#Dragon God

The identities of the original lower three positions have not been fully specified. The Technique God placed himself at the top of the ranking and established the other upper positions around the same period.

During the Laplace War, Dragon God Urupen, then ranked fourth, fought the second-ranked Demon God Laplace. Urupen's victory caused their positions to change, placing the Dragon God in second and the Demon God in fourth. Although an early account states that every Seven Great Power except the Technique God participated in the Laplace War, later clarification establishes that the Fighting God Armor did not participate in the conflict. The war and the centuries that followed left several positions without their original holders and caused repeated succession among the lower ranks. Meanwhile, the identities and whereabouts of the upper-ranked Powers became increasingly obscure, and general knowledge of the Seven Great Powers declined.

300px|thumb|A Seven Great Powers monument on the Holy Sword Highway, Millis Continent
Stone monuments representing the Seven Great Powers are scattered throughout the world, particularly in areas with high concentrations of mana. Each monument is approximately knee-high and bears the character "7" in the Fighting God language. The motifs representing the seven positions surround the central character, beginning with the first-ranked Power above it and continuing clockwise in numerical order. When the ranking changes, the corresponding motif on the monuments is automatically replaced by that of the new holder.

The Seven Great Powers is a succession-based ranking rather than a continuous comparison of every warrior in the world. Defeating a ranked Power is one means by which a position can be inherited, while vacancies and succession have also caused the lower positions to change over time. Consequently, numerical rank does not necessarily correspond to the current combat strength of every holder. A ranked individual may remain above stronger warriors who have never displaced them, while warriors comparable to the lower Seven Great Powers can remain outside the ranking entirely. The Fighting God is a special case. The entity registered in the ranking is the Fighting God Armor itself. Defeating or killing its wearer is therefore insufficient to alter the third position; the armor must be destroyed beyond recovery for its ranking to change. This distinction remained relevant during the final battle in the Biheiril Kingdom.

*The Technique God is believed to have established the Seven Great Powers in order to find warriors capable of defeating him. *After the Laplace War, the Technique God became so obscure that some people came to doubt whether he had ever existed. *The Seven Great Powers are commonly divided into the upper ranks and lower ranks. The first four positions form the upper ranks, while the fifth through seventh form the lower ranks. When it broke through the ice and attacked him, Reidar received its decisive strike with his worn sword and killed it with a counterattack that severed its head. Although the king rewarded Reidar with enough treasure to live comfortably for the rest of his life, he broke his promise and refused to give him either his daughter or the throne.

As such, Practitioners of the Water God Style are supposed to stay calm and collected at all times. The North God Style is a practical school of combat that places greater emphasis on surviving, adapting to the situation, and finding a way to win than on adhering to a fixed set of sword techniques. Its teachings include making use of the surrounding environment, administering emergency treatment during battle, and continuing to fight even after suffering serious injuries or the loss of a body part. Because of its practicality, it is particularly popular among adventurers and mercenaries. The style was founded by the first North God, Kalman I. Although Kalman himself fought with a sword, his philosophy did not require practitioners to restrict themselves to one. The original mainline of his school eventually disappeared, and the North God Style practiced in later generations primarily inherited his way of life and approach to combat rather than his original sword techniques. Many techniques associated with the modern school were instead developed by later swordsmen following those principles. One of the school's teachings is for practitioners to seek out the method of fighting best suited to them.

Its history became obscured by conflicting legends. According to the North God Heroic Tales, it was a swordsmanship devised by Kalman specifically to defeat the Immortal Demon Lord Atoferatofe Rybak. Another tradition instead claims that the Immortal Demon Lord learned or imitated the swordsmanship used by the North God. Because it came to be wielded by an Immortal Demon Lord, it was also known as the Immortal King's Sword. ==History==
===Second Great Human-Demon War===
The Central Continent was previously part of a larger landmass known as the Great Continent which the Demon Continent was also part of. This giant continent, however, was split into the present-day Central and Demon Continents by the end of the Second Great Human-Demon War due to a Mana Calamity triggered by the

bolumler.metin: The Central Continent was previously part of a larger landmass known as the Great Continent which the Demon Continent was also part of. This giant continent, however, was split into the present-day Central and Demon Continents by the end of the Second Great Human-Demon War due to a Mana Calamity triggered by the dying Demon Dragon-King Laplace. After the war ended, the Central Continent and the Demon Continent was newly formed leaving the Ringus Sea in between. The western half of the Great Continent was predominantly populated by humans and naturally, after the splitting, the Central Continent had a human-majority populace.

When Demon God Laplace began his famous campaign from the Demon Continent, now referred to as the Laplace War, he put the whole Central Continent in great distress. In a short time, he had gained total control of the north and the south. Then from both directions, he pressed his assault on the western region. The whole continent was close to being dominated by the demons' force. Laplace was eventually defeated and sealed away with the help of many heroes and the humans entered a treaty with a neutral Demon King and lifted the barricades between the ports ushering the path towards the present age.

By the conclusion of the Laplace War only the Kingdom of Asura remained on on central continent. It wasn't until about a century afterwards that the King Dragon Realm established sovereignty in the south, and another century before the Shirone Kingdom would join the hegemony.

The Red Wyrm Mountains is an enormous chain of mountain and hills that runs across and down the continent separating the land into three parts - the North, the West and the South - with their own distinct geography. The name originates from during the Laplace War when Laplace released his dreaded wyrm dragons in the mountains to block the passage of humans. The mountain range starts from the northwest where it is known as the Red Wyrm's Upper Jaw and runs across the lands until it forks into two more ranges. One range runs across the landmass without much deviation all the way to the east, and this part has been known as the Crying Wyrm mountain ranges. The other range runs down the continent almost up to the mid-point southern coastline where it abruptly ends to open a route that is mostly used by the people for traversing between the west and the south.

The northern continent, referred to as the the "Northern Territories", is a cold region which lies east to the Red Wyrm's Upper Jaw and Crying Wyrm mountain ranges which run horizontally across the continent. The region receives heavy snowfall and the soil is infertile for crops but large expanse of forests are also present. The majority of the nations in this region are poor and weak and often have skirmishes over resources. Many strong monsters appear in this region which attracts warriors-in-training and veteran adventurers. Notable locations in the north:

*Wyrm's Whiskers: A monster-infested forest separating the Northern Territories from the northern part of the Kingdom of Asura. It is home to many bandits and criminals who have fled from the Kingdom. *Kingdom of Ranoa: It is one of the three Magic Nations alliance known for its institutions of magical learning. **Sharia: One of the largest cities in the Kingdom of Ranoa.

The western continent is a prosperous region that lies between the Red Wyrm's Upper Jaw and the Lower Jaw mountain range. It is abundant with rivers and fertile plains but not many large forests are found. Monsters that appear in this region are fairly weak and knights of the Kingdom carry out exterminations to keep the commonfolk safe, which is one of the reasons as to why it is not a popular place for adventurers despite the riches of the lands. Notable locations in the west:

*Asura Kingdom: A kingdom which holds autonomy over the west. Not only is it the richest kingdom in the world but its royal capital - Ars, is also the largest city in the world.

The Great Demon Empress Kishirika Kishirisu, seeking vengeance for a thousand-year old grudge, brought the Beast Race and Ocean Race to the Demon side and waged war for the second time against the Human Race. This time the Human Race was pushed back and cornered but the war still went on for several centuries without surrendering. At the time of distress of the Humans, the Demon Dragon King Laplace joined the war to annihilate the Demon Army singlehandedly which allowed the Human Army to retake their frontlines. On the verge of death, Laplace performed the reincarnation Magic of the Dragon Race but the spell went out of control and the released force of Mana was so strong that it split the Great Continent into two - now known as the Central Continent and the Demon Continent - forming a new sea in the middle now referred to as the Ringus Sea. This event marked the end of the Second Great Human-Demon War which lasted for 800 years.

The Laplace War (ラプラス戦役 Rapurasu Sen'eki) was a war that lasted between 500 - 400 years prior to the main story. The one who united all the Demons of the Demon Continent and launched this assault against the Humans was the Demon God Laplace - a human-hating Demon who was split from the failed reincarnation attempt of Demon Dragon King Laplace in the previous war. Demon God Laplace spawned approximately a thousand years ago. In a extremely short period of time, he rallied the Demons and conquered the Demon Continent. bolumler.metin: In the un-recordable times, before the Six-Faced World was created, there existed the powerful "maker of worlds" simply known as the God of Creation (創造神 - Sōzō-shin). He felt he was slowly dying and would not last for much longer, so he tasked himself to create one last world before his time was up. However, he realized he did not have enough power left to build a stable world; the new world that he had created was severely deformed and unbalanced so he decided to create yet another world. It ended up as another distorted world, nonetheless he kept going until he finished making six worlds: the Dragon World, the Demon World, the Beast World, the Ocean World, the Sky World and the Human World, with a seventh Void World of nothingness at the center. They were all distorted worlds which would soon collapse on its own, so The Creator stuck the six worlds together and was finally able to achieve stability. In this manner he established the Six-Faced World where each world supported the balance of the others. Still not content, The Creator decided to carefully manage the worlds until the inhabitants can settle and stabilize. With his remaining strength, he divided his body into six alter ego's and descended onto their respective worlds.

The Dragon World (龍の世界 Ryū no Sekai) is the world of dragons ruled by the Dragon God, where the sky and the land are reversed. It was inhabited by a race with enormous power. The Dragon Tribe were once primitive species who were not able to develop civilization due to their harsh environment and rogue dragons but that soon changed after Human God lent the knowledge of the humans to the Dragon God. The Dragon Race taught inhabitants of the other worlds how to manifest Battle Aura.

The Demon World (魔の世界 Ma no Sekai) is the world of demons ruled by the Demon God, full of miasma and noxious mist. It was inhabited races with extraordinary physiques. Similar to the Dragon Race, the Demon Race were once primitive due to their harsh environment where demonic beasts roamed and reliance on their extraordinary bodies, but the world soon changed into an orderly style after the Human God lent the knowledge of the humans to the Demon God. The Demon Race taught inhabitants of the other worlds how to reinforce a weak body in order to use Battle Aura efficiently.

The Beast World (獣の世界 Kemono no Sekai) is the world of beasts ruled by the Beast God, with dense forests and mountains. It was inhabited by races with keen senses and powerful talons. The Beast Race taught inhabitants of the other worlds how to capture and tame monsters and wild beasts.

The Ocean World (海の世界 Umi no Sekai) is a world of water ruled by the Ocean God. It was teeming with life, inhabited by races with gills, fins and scales. The Ocean Race taught inhabitants of the other worlds how to purify water and methods of storing it.

The Sky World (天の世界 Ten no Sekai) is a world of rocks floating in the sky ruled by the Sky God. It was inhabited by a winged race who flew freely in the sky. The Sky Race taught inhabitants of the other worlds how to study and predict weather. ===Human World===
The Human World (人の世界 Hito no Sekai) is a world of flatlands and prairies ruled by the Human God. It is inhabited by a race with weak bodies but brilliant minds. The Human Race taught inhabitants of the other worlds about the importance of reading, writing, communal living, social order et cetera and gave the light of civilization to the races. After the fall of the other five worlds, all the survivors fled to the Human World and settled in their suitable habitats. In this manner, the Human World is now filled with a variety of races.

bolumler.metin: Ancient members of the Dragon Tribe possessed humanoid bodies covered in scales, with wings growing from their backs as well as sharp claws and fangs suited for combat. They were also capable of seeing in darkness. The race is associated with silver hair and golden eyes in later surviving or mixed descendants. Individual ancient Dragon Tribe members could possess differently colored metallic scales; for example, the Five Dragon Generals are described with distinct scale coloration.

The Dragon World was an exceptionally hostile environment inhabited by numerous species of giant dragons. In ancient times, the Dragon Tribe was comparatively weak and survived by hiding in caves along the mountainsides to avoid these predators. This changed with the appearance of the First Dragon God. He demonstrated the latent power residing within the Dragon Tribe and taught them how to use Dragon Aura. By drawing out this power, members of the race could multiply their physical abilities and harden their bodies sufficiently to fight the dragons that had previously threatened them. The Dragon Tribe subsequently became the dominant race of the Dragon World and began hunting dragons in organized groups. Their civilization continued to expand, developing settlements, administrative institutions, research facilities and organized Dragon Warriors. The Dragon Tribe also exchanged knowledge with other worlds after contact between the Six Worlds became established.

Following the death of Lunaria and the conflicts between the worlds, the First Dragon God was manipulated into waging war against the other worlds. Hitogami later revealed that he had engineered the conflict in order to create an opportunity to eliminate the First Dragon God. After the First Dragon God and the surviving Dragon Generals had been critically weakened, Hitogami shattered the First Dragon God's divine jewel. He then launched an attack directly into the Dragon World, initiating the collapse of the world itself. Most of the Dragon Tribe died during the destruction. Because the Dragon World collapsed considerably faster than the other destroyed worlds, only a very small number escaped into the Human World. Many of those survivors were subsequently killed by members of other races whose peoples had suffered during the Dragon Tribe's wars. According to Laplace, the surviving population eventually fell below the number necessary for the Dragon Tribe to continue as a viable species.

The Dragon World was the original home of the Dragon Tribe. Its geography was inverted relative to the Human World: mountains descended from above while the open sky lay beneath them. Enormous dragons inhabited both the mountains and the skies. Earth Dragons inhabited regions near the bases of the mountains, while Red and Blue Dragons nested closer to the upper regions. Red Dragons were aggressive and territorial and became the primary dragons hunted and eaten by the Dragon Tribe. By Laplace's youth, the Dragon Tribe had become dominant enough that Red Dragons were increasingly domesticated as well. A traditional rumor claimed that an enormous black serpent lived beneath the lower reaches of the sky and consumed corpses that fell into the depths, although even Dora stated that she had never personally seen it.

Kayos was the principal city and administrative center of the Dragon Tribe. It was carved into the middle of Dragon Roar Mountain, the largest mountain at the center of the Dragon World. As the headquarters of Dragon Tribe civilization, Kayos had the largest population and contained members of every clan. Important facilities included the First Dragon God's residence, administrative and postal institutions, a library, research facilities, livestock facilities, food stores and a base for the Dragon Warriors. The Dragon Tribe also maintained 122 other settlements throughout the world. Even the smaller settlements possessed enough military strength to annihilate a Red Dragon nest, as communities lacking such strength would be vulnerable to destruction by the surrounding dragons.

The were the five most powerful members of the Dragon Tribe appointed by the First Dragon God to assist in protecting and administering the Dragon World. Each belonged to a different Dragon Tribe clan and was entrusted with important responsibilities on the Dragon God's behalf. ===Szilard===
Szilard was the Dragon General of the and the leader of the Five Dragon Generals. He supervised the Dragon Warriors and performed a broad administrative role within Dragon Tribe society. During the First Dragon God's absence, Szilard effectively acted as the second-highest authority in the Dragon World and coordinated the other Dragon Generals. ===Dora===
Dora was the Dragon General of the and was regarded as particularly loyal to the First Dragon God. Her principal responsibility was the training and domestication of dragons. She also personally trained Laplace in the fundamental combat methods of the Dragon Tribe.

= Ogre =
Ogres are a race of large, immensely powerful humanoid beings native to the world of Mushoku Tensei. While historically feared as monsters in some regions, they are a civilized race with their own society, culture, and deep historical ties to the Human nation of the Biheiril Kingdom. == Physical Characteristics ==
Ogres are characterized by their massive, muscular builds and imposing stature, often standing close to three meters tall. Their most distinctive physical traits include:

* Skin: Bright red or reddish-brown skin. * Head: Enormous heads with a heavily protruding lower jaw, from which two long fangs extend upward. They also possess large, prominent horns sprouting from their messy hair.

Ogres are characterized by their massive, muscular builds and imposing stature, often standing close to three meters tall. Their most distinctive physical traits include:

* Skin: Bright red or reddish-brown skin. * Head: Enormous heads with a heavily protruding lower jaw, from which two long fangs extend upward. They also possess large, prominent horns sprouting from their messy hair. * Build: Incredibly broad and thick limbs (arms, legs, and necks described as "thick as tree trunks"), granting them overwhelming physical strength.

The majority of the Ogre Tribe resides on Ogre Island, a volcanic island located in the ocean to the east of the Biheiril Kingdom. The island features a rugged, rustic environment, and its inhabitants are known to be excellent fishermen.

Ogres are bilingual but have distinct proficiencies. They are fluent in the Demon Tongue, speaking it with a dignified air. However, when speaking the Human Tongue, they do so with a strong, heavy accent, as if they have only recently learned it.

A staple of Ogre culture is a traditional drink made from fermented beans, which closely resembles soy sauce in smell and taste. While popular among Ogres, this black liquid is highly potent and can be poisonous to humans if consumed undiluted.

* Peacemaking: Ogres have a specific custom for resolving conflicts. After a battle, if they reach an agreement or make peace with an opponent, they share a drink together to "wash the slate clean." This is known as "Ogre-style peacemaking." During toasts, they may use phrases such as "On the ogre's horns."
* Protection of Non-Combatants: Ogres place a high value on the lives of their non-combatants (women, children, and the elderly). Their leaders will prioritize the safety of these individuals above all else, even to the point of surrendering or withdrawing from a conflict.

bolumler.ad: The Founding of the Biheiril Kingdom
bolumler.metin: Historically, the Ogre Tribe was persecuted and driven to the brink of extinction or slavery by the Ocean Race (Merfolk/Fishmen). They were saved by a party of four adventurers (described in local legend as a knight, a dog, a monkey, and a pheasant) who ventured to Ogre Island seeking treasure. Seeing the dire state of the Ogre Tribe, the adventurers fought alongside them to slay the chief of the Ocean Tribe. All the Human adventurers perished in the battle except for the knight who led them. Deeply indebted, the Ogre God swore lifelong friendship to the surviving knight. It was later revealed that this knight was a prince from a newly emergent human nation. Upon returning home and becoming king, he established a formal treaty of mutual protection with the Ogre Tribe.

Chaos Breaker is a sky castle that previously belongs to Armored Dragon King Dora and later the residence of her son Perugius Dola. ==Design==
When flying above the sky, Chaos Breaker looks like a giant mass of rock covered in dragon scales originating in the Dragon World. Sitting on the rock is a gigantic castle taller than the Silver Palace home of the royal family of Asura Kingdom that has a garden of similar size and a river. ==Background==

bolumler.metin: When flying above the sky, Chaos Breaker looks like a giant mass of rock covered in dragon scales originating in the Dragon World. Sitting on the rock is a gigantic castle taller than the Silver Palace home of the royal family of Asura Kingdom that has a garden of similar size and a river.

Chaos Breaker is first used by Armored Dragon King Dora during the battle of the Dragon Generals against the First Dragon God at the final years of the Six-Faced World Era. As Chaos Breaker approaches, the First Dragon God fired torrents of power to the fortress but it was protected by spirits summoned by the Dragon Generals. After withstanding a few more shots of the barrage fired by the First Dragon God, the spirits disappear after exhausting their power. The First Dragon God then draws his Godsword and with a single strike everything was carved in half including Chaos Breaker which the upper part fell toward the sky while its lower half remained floating since the function of its core remained intact. During the Laplace Wars, Chaos Breaker is summoned by Perugius Dola and together with his 12 familiars and other heroes, they managed to seal Laplace, and Perugius is known as a hero of the war with the new era named "Armored Dragon Era" in his honor. After growing tired of the palace life in Asura Kingdom, Perugius left and to this day travels the world with Chaos Breaker, vigilantly watching over any signs of Laplace's revival to defeat him and get revenge for the death of his friends.

MT-AN-S3-E08-PNG-03.png|Nanahoshi blowing the flute
MT-AN-S3-E08-PNG-04.png|Rudeus' group holding the baton provided by Almanfi
MT-AN-S3-E08-PNG-05.png|The Magic Circle serving as the entry point in Chaos Breaker

To gain entry to Chaos Breaker, you must be at a Monument of Seven Great Powers then blow a golden flute with out any finger holes which is provided by Perugius so in a sense only those who Perugius knows are able to enter or if accompanied by them. The music of the flute that is not heard by Human ears will be heard by Clearnight of Thunder, one of Perugius' familiars who will inform Almanfi. Almanfi will then teleport to the corresponding monument where the flute is used and he will decide if entry to Chaos Breaker will be granted which so far, Demons are forbidden entry. Almanfi then provides those he allows entry a baton and instructs them to hold onto it with their bare hands and departs to inform Perugius. Perugius will then use Teleportation Magic to transport those holding the baton to Chaos Breaker and upon doing so, they seen standing at a huge Magic Circle about 20 meters wide with water running through the engraved patterns and emiting a faint light. Sylvaril will then welcome those who arrive and serve as their guide.

250px|right|thumb|Sylvaril guiding Rudeus' Group through the Garden
The exterior of Chaos Breaker has expansive garden that have trees and colorful flowers that makes it look like a maze with a canal in front of it with water sparkling in the light that can easily be seen that it is well taken care of.

250px|right|thumb|Chaos Breaker's Throne Room in the Anime

The entrance to the Throne Room (Also known as Audience Room) is a pair of heavy doors dotted with silver and has a dragon painted on each side which took almost an hour to walk from arriving from the outside to get here. Beyond the door is an enormous hall where the tall ceilings are supported by tree-like pillars and ligh radiates from above that is of luxurious and brilliance. The walls have curtains of complex patterns that are products of Asura Kingdom and the Holy Country of Millis. The walls also has the emblems of Dragon God Orsted and Five Dragon Generals showing the deep association of Chaos Breaker to the Dragon Tribe. The floor has a red carpet and leading to the stairs of 10 steps where the famed 12 Familiars of Perugius stands at attention and above the stairs is Perugius sitting on his throne overlooking the entire hall with the emblem of Dora is seen above.

MT-AN-S3-E09-PNG-03.png|Sickbay in the Anime Season 3

The Sickbay is used to treat people who are in need of medical care which has furniture similar to guest rooms but the interior is made of windowless stone with beds, has an operating table in the center of the room and a cabinet containing various medical supplies like knives, bandages and other medical supplies. Yuruzu can also utilize her ability to Transfer Health to patients that cannot be treated with Healing Magic while Karowante can do diagnosis with his ability for such cases.

In appearance, it is basically a large bear with a white coat and a single black stripe that ran vertically down its middle. They move in sizable packs, and when winter drew near, they work together to build up huge collective stockpiles of food. At that time of year, their attacks on humans grew much more frequent.They were comparatively mellow in the summer months, when they tended to hang around sources of water to mate. bolumler.metin: After the Creator God created the Six-Faced World, he decided to use what was left of his power to split his body into 6 pieces and form divine beings who will ensure that all six worlds would prosper and to keep the worlds in balance. These six beings would come to be known as Gods to the people of their respective world.

At the suggestion of the Human God, all the Gods formed a council to share information and knowledge with each other to benefit their worlds. The Gods would regularly meet, trade information, and discuss the state of the Six-Face World.

The God Wars (not the official name) began when the first Dragon God declared war on 4 of the 6 worlds in order to search for the murderers of his wife, Lunaria. Evidence pointed to a conspiracy of these four worlds that resulted in Lunaria's murder, and so the Dragon God and his five Dragon Generals began their massacre on the Beast world, followed by the Ocean World, the Heaven World, and finally the Demon world. Each time, the Dragon God faced off and killed one of the Gods while his Dragon Generals committed genocide on the world populations. The Human God then opened a rift to allow the survivors of those worlds to escape into the human world.

After the war was won, the Dragon God ordered his Dragon Generals to invade the Human World, even though the Human God was their ally. The Dragon Generals then turned on him in order to stop his rampage but were eventually defeated. In the battle's final moments, the Human God appeared and struck down the Dragon God, revealing himself as the mastermind of the entire war. The Dragon God also revealed that he knew the god who defeated him was not the Human God, but an unknown entity wearing the Human God's form who then dubbed himself Hitogami. After which, Hitogami destroyed the Dragon world however the dying Dragon God challenged the trickster to a final fight that ended with the Dragon God's death and Hitogami's imprisonment in the Void World. With all the Gods dead and Hitogami imprisoned, the Age of the Gods faded into legends.

The power of the Gods was immense, they could destroy an entire world without too much effort and were impossible to kill by anyone or anything other than another God. Wounds inflicted by Gods would take around a century to heal even if they are inflicted on another God. The Dragon God's blood had healing properties, and the Demon God could change his size to more than 200 meters (it's unknown if this was exclusive to him or if all Gods could do this).

:A beautiful God with twin eyes on his forehead and six wings on his back. ===Demon God===
:A man with eight arms and six horns, spanning a height of over three meters. He was considered the second most powerful God. ===Human God===
:A featureless man with a mosaic-covered face. While he was the weakest of the Gods, he was also the most respected by all the other Gods and was considered their leader. He was the one who suggested that all the Gods come together and share their knowledge and technology with each other for the benefit of all worlds. It is due to these meetings that the Human God shared various wisdoms from his world such as the use of "Language" and "Letters" to the other Gods which greatly advanced their civilizations. ===Dragon God===
:The First Dragon God had silver hair, skin covered in silver scale, golden eyes, sharp claws and fangs.
